webview.notes: D-pad video controls; continue watching for long videos; send a link from your phone with a QR code, and back up or restore bookmarks the same way; a This site panel for per-site text size, cursor mode and blocking; rename, reorder, export and import bookmarks; assign spare remote buttons; drag mode; background tabs unload to save memory and a closed tab can be reopened; a guided update dialog; removing a download from the list keeps the file.
